definition: Patient transfer moves a patient safely between positions, surfaces or care locations while managing mobility and continuity of care.
entry_text: Patient transfer moves a patient safely between positions, surfaces or care locations while managing mobility and continuity of care.
example: A care team uses the appropriate equipment to move a patient from a bed to a chair.
label: Patient transfer
sense_note: May refer to physical movement or transfer of care between facilities; document the intended sense.
